pairs.subject: error-handling
pairs.evidence: features/lawwatch/sectorAttribution.ts:193 Malformed rows in the sector-attribution payload are silently dropped at the row level without preserving item identity or alerting an error door.

techniques.evidence: features/lawwatch/components/RadarLedger.tsx:179 Context only clears a local component timer; no cancellable asynchronous operations or AbortController signals are used.
features/lawwatch/getDependencyData.ts:147 The loader exposes an opaque null return on failure instead of a discriminated error enumeration or structured aggregate for consumers.
features/lawwatch/deriveRadar.ts:18 Context operates purely over stateless, read-only data transformations with no mutable session or document state requiring containment restoration.
features/lawwatch/getRadarData.ts:22 The async loader executes without a handled-path crash reporter or top-level loader try/catch guard.
features/lawwatch/getRadarData.ts:23 When both collision and law datasets are absent, loadRadarData returns null without routing the failure to telemetry or a log door.
features/lawwatch/radarFeedCodecs.ts:1 Context produces RSS and JSON feed projections for web routes, not a process exit code for CLI or process supervisors.
features/lawwatch/sectorAttribution.ts:145 When a raw sector attribution row lacks required fields, it is discarded to null rather than decoding into an identity-preserving failure item.
features/lawwatch/deriveRadar.ts:65 Context defines domain finding kinds rather than declaring an internal never-fires assertion error class.
features/lawwatch/getDependencyData.ts:146 The caught exception is intercepted and converted to a null return value, stripping structured category and cause across the layer boundary.
features/lawwatch/components/RadarLedger.tsx:194 Clipboard failure is caught and logged solely to the client console, leaving the failure swallowed from operator telemetry.
features/lawwatch/getDependencyData.ts:145 Caught errors are treated as untyped exceptions rather than classified into a closed taxonomy specifying transience or fault lines.
features/lawwatch/components/RadarLedger.tsx:195 Failed actions toggle a local boolean status to display a static string rather than resolving through a structured message-and-suggestion registry.
